title: Radio Paradise Application Logs
description: Application INFO/WARN/ERROR and any emitted DEBUG/TRACE logs. All includes unclassified startup lines. Retention 7 days; up to 2000 entries per panel, narrow the time window for more. New Java stack traces are grouped (up to 256 lines / 3s).

list.name: mdcField
list.label: MDC field
list.description: Choose the request field to filter. Values are parsed at query time, without indexing request data.

list.name: mdcValue
list.label: MDC value (exact or regex)
list.description: Case-sensitive. Use .* for all logs, sinan-was-here for an exact value, or .*Chrome.* to match part of a value.

options.content: Choose **MDC field** and enter an **MDC value**: `sinan-was-here` matches exactly; `.*Chrome.*` matches part of a value. Reset to `.*` to show all logs, including those without request context. Filters apply to the chart and both log panels. **Search text** searches the entire log line. Values are case-sensitive. Expand a log entry to inspect parsed MDC fields. Retention is 7 days; panels show up to 2,000 entries. Narrow the time range for busy periods. For live tail, use **Explore → Loki → Live**.

targets.expr: sum by(severity) (count_over_time({job="docker",service="app"} | regexp "(?s)^[^\\n]*?\\s(?P<severity>TRACE|DEBUG|INFO|WARN|ERROR|FATAL)\\s" | severity=~"${level:regex}" |= ${search:json} | pattern `<_> traceId=<traceId> requestId=<requestId> clientIp="<clientIp>" httpMethod="<httpMethod>" requestPath="<requestPath>" userAgent="<userAgent>" httpStatus=<httpStatus> durationMs=<durationMs> <_>` | ${mdcField:raw} =~ ${mdcValue:json} | keep severity [$__auto]))

{job="docker",service="app"} | regexp "(?s)^[^\\n]*?\\s(?P<severity>TRACE|DEBUG|INFO|WARN|ERROR|FATAL)\\s" | severity=~"${level:regex}" |= ${search:json} | pattern `<_> traceId=<traceId> requestId=<requestId> clientIp="<clientIp>" httpMethod="<httpMethod>" requestPath="<requestPath>" userAgent="<userAgent>" httpStatus=<httpStatus> durationMs=<durationMs> <_>` | ${mdcField:raw} =~ ${mdcValue:json}

{job="docker",service="app"} | regexp "(?s)^[^\\n]*?\\s(?P<severity>TRACE|DEBUG|INFO|WARN|ERROR|FATAL)\\s" | severity=~"WARN|ERROR|FATAL" |= ${search:json} | pattern `<_> traceId=<traceId> requestId=<requestId> clientIp="<clientIp>" httpMethod="<httpMethod>" requestPath="<requestPath>" userAgent="<userAgent>" httpStatus=<httpStatus> durationMs=<durationMs> <_>` | ${mdcField:raw} =~ ${mdcValue:json}
